units.source_text: 花固然美，千重子却喜欢去看新叶的嫩绿。

en.t: Flowers were beautiful, of course, but Chieko liked to go and look at the tender green of the new leaves.

units.source_text: 高雄附近枫树的新叶自不消说，若王子一带的，她也很喜欢。

en.t: Needless to say, she loved the new maple leaves near Takao, and she was also very fond of those around Nyakuoji.
